product_overview: OpenScout is an AI-powered job search and interview platform that helps candidates prepare via CV analysis and mock interviews, and lets employers post and manage jobs. The app uses Supabase for auth/data and Stripe for employer subscriptions.
core_goals: Enable candidates to create a complete profile and improve hiring outcomes via CV analysis and AI mock interviews
Provide a browsable jobs marketplace and a simple apply flow for candidates
Give employers tools to create and manage job listings and view qualified applications behind a subscription
Protect core routes and integrate Supabase auth and Stripe billing for gated employer features

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to sign in with email and password using Supabase authentication and access protected areas.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill incorrect password -> Click Login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a new user account with email and password and confirm email address.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill email and password fields -> Submit registration form -> See confirmation message -> Navigate to /confirm-email
Navigate to /register -> Leave required field empty or enter invalid email -> Submit registration form -> See validation error message

features.name: Onboarding / Profile Completion
features.description: Five-step profile onboarding to collect About, Work Experience, Education, Job Preferences and Links (used to gate access to dashboard features).
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Fill required fields: name, email, location -> Add work experience entry -> Add education entry -> Add LinkedIn link -> Submit profile -> See redirect to /dashboard with profile marked complete
Navigate to /onboarding -> Leave name or location empty -> Attempt to submit profile -> See validation error preventing submission
Navigate to /onboarding -> Attempt to add work experience or education -> Click Add -> See add action fail or no new entry created -> See inline error message

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated user landing showing cards/links for CV Analysis, Mock Interview, Jobs and onboarding status.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See dashboard cards for CV analysis, mock interview and jobs -> Click CV analysis card -> Navigate to /cv-analysis
Navigate to /dashboard while not logged in -> See redirect to /login
Navigate to /dashboard with incomplete onboarding -> See prompt to complete profile -> Click complete profile -> Navigate to /onboarding

features.name: CV Analysis
features.description: Upload a CV (PDF/TXT) to receive an AI-generated score and detailed analysis via the backend /api/cv-analysis endpoint.
user_flows: Navigate to /cv-analysis -> Click upload CV -> Select PDF file -> Click Analyze -> Backend POST to /api/cv-analysis returns results -> See analysis score and report
Navigate to /cv-analysis -> Click upload CV -> Select unsupported file type or corrupted file -> Click Analyze -> See upload or validation error message
Navigate to /cv-analysis -> Select PDF -> Click Analyze -> Network or backend error occurs -> See error notification and option to retry

features.name: Mock Interview
features.description: Run an AI-driven mock interview session with voice prompts (TTS), microphone input, and post-session feedback and result pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /mock-interview -> Click Start mock interview -> System creates session and navigates to /mock-interview/[sessionId] -> Run microphone test and confirm microphone access -> Hear first question via TTS -> Answer the question by speaking -> Continue through questions -> Finish session -> Navigate to /mock-interview/[sessionId]/result -> See result and feedback

Navigate to /mock-interview -> Click Start mock interview -> System creates session and navigates to /mock-interview/[sessionId] -> Microphone test fails or user denies permission -> See 'microphone not detected' or permission error and instructions to enable microphone

Navigate to /mock-interview -> During session the app plays question audio via TTS -> TTS pronunciation is incorrect or unintelligible -> User toggles to text-only mode or requests TTS retry -> See updated playback or text prompt
Navigate to /mock-interview -> During session speak an answer but speech is not recognized -> See prompt 'I didn't catch that, could you repeat?' -> Re-speak answer

features.name: Jobs Listing and Apply
features.description: Public job listings and details with a protected apply flow that requires an authenticated candidate profile and optionally checks CV score or interview status.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Browse jobs list -> Click a job -> Navigate to /jobs/[jobId] -> Click Apply -> If logged in navigate to /jobs/[jobId]/apply -> Fill application form -> Submit application -> Backend POST to /api/job-applications returns success -> See application confirmation
Navigate to /jobs -> Click a job -> Click Apply -> If not logged in see redirect to /login
Navigate to /jobs -> Open job detail -> Click Apply -> Fill application form -> Submit -> Backend returns error -> See submission error message and option to retry

features.name: Employer Job Management
features.description: Employer panel to create and edit job listings, manage company ownership, view applications, and access subscription pricing and checkout.
user_flows: Log in as an employer -> Navigate to /employer -> See employer job list -> Click Create new job -> Navigate to /employer/new -> Fill job form -> Submit -> See new job appear in /employer job list

Navigate to /employer/pricing -> Click Subscribe -> Backend POST to /api/employer/create-checkout-session is triggered -> Complete Stripe checkout -> Backend verifies session via /api/employer/verify-session -> See subscription active in /employer
Navigate to /employer -> Select existing job -> Click Edit -> Navigate to /employer/[jobId]/edit -> Update fields -> Save changes -> See updated job in job list

Navigate to /employer -> Open job with applications -> Click Applications -> Navigate to /employer/[jobId]/applications -> Click an application -> Navigate to /employer/[jobId]/applications/[applicationId] -> See application detail
Navigate to /employer as non-subscriber -> Attempt to view applications -> See prompt to subscribe and link to /employer/pricing
